_meta.description: Primordial Star (Primostar) conversion tables from the eog.gg star calculator: per-season points per level, points per star, flat grant, scoring floors, Season 1 milestone ladder, and the calculator's default cost assumptions. kind = season_conversion | s1_star_milestone | calculator_assumption. See sources/notes/eog.md.

calculator_default_caps.skill_max_level: equals character level at season end

records.formula: stars = flat_star_grant + score / points_per_star (+ stars carried from earlier seasons); score = sum over components of max(0, level - floor) x slots x points. Required score for a target = (target - flat_star_grant - owned) x points_per_star
records.notes: Weights from the published Season 1 breakdown, cross-checked by eog against two player-built calculators.
